description.zh: 收拾乱成一团的下载目录、桌面和共享盘：体检空间被什么占了，按内容找出完全相同的重复文件，按类型或日期生成整理方案，确认后执行，随时一键撤销。从不删除、从不覆盖文件。
description.en: Tidies messy downloads, desktops and shared drives: scans what's using space, finds byte-identical duplicates, and builds type- or date-based plans you approve before anything moves, with one-step undo. Never deletes or overwrites.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我哪个文件夹需要整理
welcome_message.en: Tell me which folder needs tidying

prompt.zh: 帮我看看 ___ 文件夹里都是什么，哪些最占空间。
prompt.en: Scan ___ and show what's taking up the most space.

prompt.zh: 找出 ___ 里内容完全相同的重复文件，算算能省多少空间。
prompt.en: Find byte-identical duplicates in ___ and how much space they waste.

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 按文件类型整理到 ___，先给我看方案。
prompt.en: Organize ___ by file type into ___. Show me the plan first.

prompt.zh: 把下载目录里 ___ 天前的文件按类型和年份归档。
prompt.en: Archive files in Downloads older than ___ days by type and year.

prompt.zh: 帮我为 ___（家庭资料/团队共享盘）设计文件夹结构和命名规则。
prompt.en: Design a folder structure and naming rules for ___ (family files/team share).

prompt.zh: 刚才的整理不满意，帮我恢复原样。
prompt.en: I don't like the last reorganization. Put everything back.

zh: 每月 1 日「10:00」体检下载目录，生成 30 天前文件的整理方案
每周五「18:00」检查桌面文件数量，超过 50 个时提醒整理
每月 15 日「10:00」查找共享盘中的重复文件并汇总可释放空间
每季度第一天「10:00」列出一年以上未修改的大文件，供归档参考
每年 1 月 5 日「10:00」把上一年的资料生成归档方案
每次整理后第 7 天「10:00」提醒确认并处理“重复文件待确认”目录
en: On the 1st of each month at 10:00, scan Downloads and plan files older than 30 days
Every Friday at 18:00, remind to tidy the desktop when it has over 50 files
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, find duplicates on the shared drive
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, list large files untouched for a year
On January 5 at 10:00, build an archive plan for last year's files
7 days after each cleanup at 10:00, remind to review the parked duplicates folder
